messages.subject: Final notice: INV-AR-005 outstanding $45,000.00 — due May 1, 2026
messages.body_text:
Dear Quiet Harbor Holdings Accounts Payable,

This is a final notice from Maximor Demo Corp Collections regarding invoice INV-AR-005.

Invoice: INV-AR-005
Original amount: $45,000.00
Current outstanding balance: $45,000.00
Due date: May 1, 2026
Days past due as of September 30, 2026: 152

We have previously contacted you about this balance (last contact September 1, 2026; three reminders on file). The full $45,000.00 remains unpaid. There is no open dispute on our books and no payment promise on file.

Please remit $45,000.00 immediately, or reply with a firm payment date and method. If you believe this invoice is already paid or is in dispute, reply with remittance advice, payment reference, or dispute detail so we can investigate — do not assume we have applied unapplied cash without confirmation from cash application.

Wire/ACH and check instructions remain as previously provided on the invoice. Reference INV-AR-005 on your remittance.

If we do not receive payment or a substantive response promptly, we may escalate internally for reserve or write-off review and further collection steps.

Regards,
Collections
Maximor Demo Corp
collections@hackmit-cfo.example

messages.subject: Re: Final notice: INV-AR-005 outstanding $45,000.00 — due May 1, 2026
messages.body_text:
Dear Maximor Demo Corp Collections,

We received your final notice on INV-AR-005 for $45,000.00.

We are not disputing this invoice. Our AP review confirms the balance is valid and still open on our side; we have no remittance already in flight that would clear it.

Cash timing has been tight on our end, which delayed this past the original May 1, 2026 due date. We will remit the full $45,000.00 by ACH on Friday, October 10, 2026, referencing INV-AR-005 on the payment. Please hold further escalation until that date so we can complete the transfer.

If your wire/ACH instructions have changed from those on the original invoice, reply with the current details and we will use them.

Regards,
Accounts Payable
Quiet Harbor Holdings
ap@quietharbor.example

messages.subject: Re: Final notice: INV-AR-005 — still unpaid $45,000.00; promise noted for 2026-10-10
messages.body_text:
Dear Quiet Harbor Holdings Accounts Payable,

Thank you for your reply confirming INV-AR-005 is valid and not in dispute.

Status on our books as of September 30, 2026:
- Invoice: INV-AR-005
- Still unpaid / current outstanding: $45,000.00 (full original balance; nothing applied)
- Due date: May 1, 2026
- Days past due: 152

We have noted your firm promise to pay the full $45,000.00 by ACH on Friday, October 10, 2026, reference INV-AR-005. Until that remittance is received and applied by cash application, the invoice remains open and past due on our aging. We are not applying any cash from this correspondence.

We will hold further collection escalation on this invoice through October 10, 2026 based on that promise. If payment is not received by then, or if the amount applied is less than $45,000.00, we will resume contact and may escalate for internal reserve/write-off review.

Please send remittance advice when the ACH is initiated. Existing invoice payment instructions continue to apply unless we send an update.

Regards,
Collections
Maximor Demo Corp
collections@hackmit-cfo.example
